name: tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b
description: Claude Code plugins for Google Cloud TPU DevOps: the tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b-management skill and tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b MCP server for Gemma 4 vLLM serving on TPU VMs.

plugins.name: tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b
plugins.description: Gemma 4 E2B (google/gemma-4-E2B-it, bf16) in Rust on one Cloud TPU v5e chip: the forward pass emitted as StableHLO and run through libtpu's PJRT plugin, as the PyO3 module jaxrust_rs; plus TPU provisioning via the tpu-jaxrust-v5e1-2b MCP server.
